Perfect! All tests are passing now. The bug was in the `isExpired` function—it was using `<` (strictly less than) instead of `<=` (less than or equal). 

**The fix:** Changed line 7 from `return token.exp < nowSeconds;` to `return token.exp <= nowSeconds;`

This ensures tokens are correctly rejected the instant they expire, not just after. The test "token expiring exactly now is expired" was failing because when `exp === now`, the old code incorrectly returned `false` (not expired).
